tips.text: Official guidance warns visitors to purchase admission tickets exclusively through the official website due to circulating counterfeit tickets.
A former employee noted that having a Paris Museum Pass will not skip long lines unless you book a timed-entry ticket online.
Travelers note that getting to Versailles from Paris requires taking RER Line C rather than the Metro.
A visitor pointed out that a paid tram operates around the grounds, offering a cheaper alternative to renting golf carts.
Several visitors recommended renting a bicycle or golf cart to easily travel around the expansive gardens and grounds.
The Estate of Trianon opens at 12:00 PM, several hours after the main Palace opens at 9:00 AM.
A visitor noted that the garden fountains are shut down during colder months of the year to protect the pipes.
One traveler recommended booking a guided tour in advance to gain access to the private apartments behind the main state rooms.
